dashboard.subbadge: Multilingual release review for training apps and device UI
dashboard.title: Review workout, wearable, and sensor-driven UI before it ships in every locale.
dashboard.description: Inspect screenshots from fitness apps, watch surfaces, GPS summaries, and metrics-heavy product flows. OCR extracts visible copy, then the checker surfaces likely overflow, RTL, placeholder, truncation, and font fallback risks for localization teams.
dashboard.activeAssetEmpty: Waiting for a workout or device screenshot

appShell.reviewWorkspaceTitle: Validate screenshots before multilingual release handoff
appShell.reviewWorkspaceDescription: Run a focused QA pass on training flows, post-run summaries, wearable pairing screens, and metrics-heavy cards without changing the OCR or issue-detection engine.
bestInputItems: Workout result cards with tight metadata labels.
Wearable onboarding or accessory pairing flows.
Map, GPS, and sensor summary states with dynamic values.
appShell.releaseHandoffTitle: What this pass is meant to catch

releaseCards.title: Layout risk on compact surfaces
releaseCards.description: Cards, tabs, and watch-sized layouts where longer localized strings compete with metrics and icons.

releaseCards.title: Dynamic copy and placeholders
releaseCards.description: Coaching messages, achievement states, and sensor readouts that combine variables with localized text.

releaseCards.title: Script support and readability
releaseCards.description: Fallback font drift, clipped accents, and directional issues that appear only after locale expansion.

upload.title: Upload a PNG or JPG screenshot from a workout app or device UI
upload.description: Use production-like captures from training summaries, wearable setup, recovery flows, or metrics dashboards. OCR will extract visible strings and map likely localization risks directly onto the surface.
upload.invalidFile: Upload a PNG or JPG screenshot to continue.
upload.loadFailed: Failed to load the uploaded image.

canvas.description: Overlay boxes mark suspicious copy regions on the selected sports UI surface.
canvas.emptyTitle: Upload a sports product screenshot to begin.
canvas.emptyDescription: OCR output, language-specific heuristics, and flagged bounding boxes will appear here after you add a PNG or JPG from a mobile app, watch UI, or metrics-heavy device screen.

qa.title: Automated release findings
qa.subtitle: Reviewing for {{language}} with OCR extraction and sports UI localization heuristics.
qa.waitingDescription: Add a screenshot from a training app, wearable workflow, or metrics dashboard to generate OCR text and issue annotations for this locale.
qa.noIssuesTitle: No obvious issues were flagged in this pass.
qa.noIssuesDescription: The heuristics did not detect overflow, placeholder order, or clipping problems for the selected locale. A final manual pass is still recommended for typography, spacing, and brand tone.
qa.ocrOutputPlaceholder: OCR output will appear here after a screenshot is processed.

reviewGuidance.title: Release checks tuned for sports UI
reviewGuidance.expansionDescription: Prioritize dense workout cards, split labels, and compact watch layouts.
reviewGuidance.rtlDescription: Verify mirrored paddings, icon order, and directional metrics on every flagged surface.
reviewGuidance.ltrDescription: Confirm left anchoring, number formatting, and label rhythm across data-heavy screens.
reviewGuidance.priorityDescription: Focus on workout summaries, pace cards, heart-rate states, and accessory setup flows.
manualPassItems: Check unit labels, pace abbreviations, and sensor naming consistency.
Verify CTA width on goal-completion and workout-detail screens.
Review placeholders inside dynamic coaching messages and summary cards.
escalateItems: High-severity findings affect watch face constraints or post-run summaries.
Fallback fonts change metrics tone between phone and wearable surfaces.
RTL order breaks icon plus value pairs on activity, recovery, or map screens.

ocrLowText.title: OCR extracted very little text
ocrLowText.description: The screenshot did not yield enough text for a complete localization QA pass.
ocrLowText.fix: Try a higher-resolution screenshot or crop closer to the UI copy before rerunning OCR.

overflow.title: Text likely exceeds its intended container
overflow.description: The OCR box for "{{text}}" spans unusually wide and approaches the surrounding edge, which is a common overflow signal in localized UI.
overflow.fix: Increase container width, allow wrapping, or shorten the localized copy for this surface.

rtl.title: RTL text appears left-anchored or visually misaligned
rtl.description: The {{language}} line "{{text}}" is positioned like an LTR element, which may indicate mirroring or alignment problems.
rtl.fix: Right-align the container, mirror directional spacing, and verify icon-plus-text order for RTL rendering.

placeholder.title: Placeholder order may break in this locale
placeholder.description: Detected placeholder tokens in "{{text}}". Mixed-direction or reordered placeholders often break sentence structure during localization.
placeholder.fix: Use explicit placeholder ordering and verify translators can safely reorder tokens without changing meaning.

lineHeight.title: Line height looks too tight for the rendered text
lineHeight.description: The text line "{{text}}" has limited vertical space compared with adjacent OCR lines, which can clip accents, descenders, or RTL marks.
lineHeight.fix: Increase line-height or vertical padding for this component, especially for script-specific glyph marks.

truncation.title: Second line may be truncated
truncation.description: The follow-up line "{{text}}" is abruptly shorter than the line above, which often indicates clamped or hidden content.
truncation.fix: Relax line clamps, increase container height, or shorten the localized copy before release.

fontFallback.title: Font fallback risk detected for this script
fontFallback.descriptionSized: Detected unusually inconsistent glyph sizing in "{{text}}", which can happen when the UI falls back to a secondary font.
fontFallback.descriptionMissing: OCR did not confidently recover expected {{language}} script characters, which can signal fallback or script coverage problems.
fontFallback.fix: Add an explicit font stack for this script and verify the fallback family matches your intended metrics and tone.
